section: 2.2 taskB V2.1: proper pre/post ensemble + uncertainty decomposition
corrections_note: Two V2 errors corrected. (1) Pre/post-TS ensemble: V2 averaged the five seeds' HARD {-1,0,+1} predictions and rounded the mean (mislabeled "majority vote"); V2.1 averages the five 3-class softmax vectors and takes argmax - 1. (2) Uncertainty: V2 reported a single spread (std of the seed-averaged s distribution); V2.1 decomposes it via the law of total variance into s_total_predictive_std = sqrt(Var of p_bar), s_epistemic_std = sqrt(Var over seeds of per-seed E[s]) and s_within_model_std = sqrt(mean over seeds of per-seed Var[s]), with Spearman/risk-coverage reported for each. All other Task-B numbers (s/head MAEs, near-TS metrics, baselines, B0, internal-training, classical, bidirectional) are unchanged: recomputed blocks were verified to reproduce V2, non-recomputable blocks are carried over with provenance "carried_from_v2".
